text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While walking around campus, I happen to see Biwa Hayahide and Air Groove talking with each other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In short, I apologize for Brian's continued absence from student council meetings…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, you needn't apologize. I'm quite accustomed to her absence, actually. And to the president's as well, what with her outings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That said, today's meeting concerns a matter of some urgency, which means it can't be postponed over an absence or two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, allow me to attend in Brian's place.
choice_data_list: You're going to help out with the student council?
You're going to help out with the student council?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, precisely. I'm sorry but it appears today's training session might suffer a small delay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Biwa Hayahide is attending, I decide to take the opportunity to sit in and observe the meeting myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, to start with, if you would all turn your attention to the screen for today's topic…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait… where's the file? Who was the last person to update this?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm… I'm sorry! I think this might be my fault! Umm… I'm sure the data was in here—oh no!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forget it. We haven't the time to spare. I'll just improvise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That won't be necessary. I've prepared the relevant data. Here, I'll put it through the projector.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Really? I appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's this? I don't remember creating any graphs…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, I whipped that up a moment ago. I figured that the information would be easier to digest this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …All right. Well, it seems we've heard most of your opinions. Does anyone have any questions before we vote?

text_block_list.name: Absentminded Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Um, would you mind repeating that thing you mentioned earlier? What was it—I think it had to do with the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's a little vague… Do you at least remember whose statement it was?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I'm reviewing the meeting transcript. The statement was made by the third speaker.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It reads as follows, "Since the number of students in attendance has risen, I propose that we increase each dorm's stock of household supplies."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excellent work today, Air Groove. I think the meeting concluded without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hayahide! Would you consider joining the student council?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I know I've extended you countless invitations before, but today you convinced me! Your presence in the council would solve so many of our problems!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I agree with Air Groove. I only joined the meeting midway through, but from what I saw, your contributions were magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: With all due respect… I'm afraid I would lack the flexibility to balance council responsibilities with racing. Trainer, would you agree?
choice_data_list: Why not try it out for a day?
What if you join on the condition that they look after your sister?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Just for a day? I suppose I could manage that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Biwa Hayahide spends the rest of her day helping the student council with their work. However…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The pool's temperature setting? Yes, I do wonder why it's been set at this many degrees. Hmm, I might find the reason if I trace backwards through these records.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There are daily scrambles to purchase baked goods from the school store? Well, increasing the stock should solve that issue, but I wonder if something else is at play here… Okay, I'll look into it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's her tendency to go the extra mile, but Biwa Hayahide always has trouble knowing when to clock out…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide, is everything okay? You do realize it's nighttime? I believe you're pushing yourself a little hard…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's already nighttime?! I'm sorry, I didn't notice at all! Perhaps I was right to presume I'm not cut out for this…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, the role does require that you set your priorities properly. Let's have you take a hiatus from student council for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But she was getting so much done… Urk! So close!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see… That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian always goes overboard the minute I let her out of my sight. But I can't keep an eye on her all day long. With the help of the student council, though…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I must object. We don't have the means to manage that one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Agreed. We supervise her where possible, but full custody would be a tall order.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see… Then, please forget we ever discussed this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, Hayahide, you're welcome to join the student council whenever you feel so inclined! And I do mean whenever!
